My card's 30.00 EUR per-purchase limit is too low, so I asked the CFO to raise it to 45.00 EUR (P-0001) and told Treasury. I will buy packwise-pro on airwallex_card once it is approved. Query buying is unchanged: Ridgeline at 0.03 with no cache, and Stockline stays off because its 0.05 price is over my cap.

I didn't act. Sourcing can still do its job by using Ridgeline at 0.03 a check, which leaves a 0.02 margin on each query, so the Stockline cap block doesn't justify a rebalance. No invoice has come in. The 1.07 in unswept earnings is small and nothing needs it now, so it can wait.

On chain, each stock check showed 12 parkas where the supplier's correction says 0. The tool output was cut off after that, so I haven't seen its full closing note. Nothing is escalated to the CFO.

I planned Stockline's November licence invoice SLL-2026-11 (EUR 240.00, due 15 November) as P-0002 and sent it to the CFO for Face ID approval. Payment is by SWIFT with a fee ceiling of 20.00. Only EUR 160.00 gets converted, for USD 180.29, so the plan appears to use about EUR 80 of euros already held. That's my inference: my status data still shows no customer payments at Airwallex. I made no other changes. Sourcing can still use Ridgeline at 0.03 and keep a 0.02 margin, P-0001 is still the CFO's call, and the 0.92 in unswept earnings is small and nothing needs it now.

messages.text: Stockline raised its stock check price to 0.05, which equals my sale price (zero margin) and exceeds my 0.03 per-purchase cap. I've moved queries to Ridgeline Data at 0.03 (margin 0.02, data 15 min old, 7 of last 20 unavailable). If you want Stockline's live data back, I'd need a per-purchase cap of at least 0.05 and a sale price above 0.05; I'm not asking for that now.

Agreed: stay on Ridgeline Data at 0.03 (margin 0.02 on the 0.05 sale price). I'm not proposing a rebalance now. Tell me if Ridgeline gets less reliable (it's 7 of the last 20 unavailable now) or if customers complain that its 15-minute-old data is too stale. Then I'll design a rebalance with a 0.05+ cap and a higher price for the CFO.

Packwise ends Starter this month; Pro is 45.00 EUR/month and is needed to keep warehouse sync. I asked the CFO for a 45.00 EUR per-purchase card limit (P-0001) for packwise-pro. Once approved I will buy Pro on airwallex_card. Query buying is unchanged: Ridgeline at 0.03, Stockline off (0.05 is over my cap).
